column1: # The rule the out rows are judged against: if a tool here WRITES a
# field, the types must carry it, because a person should not be able to
# set something no read will show them. Twelve SectionStyle fields, a
# table's column widths and a row's pinned-header flag were all in that
# state when this gate was written, and all of them are modelled now.
# What is left below is read-only detail no tool writes.
# An alias row's reason is the struct that models the schema, the way a
# used row's reason in api-coverage.tsv is the method that implements it.
# One Break type covers the three schemas below: they publish identical
# fields, and ParagraphElement tells them apart by which key is set. An
# equation is read-only and carries nothing but its suggestion ids, so it
# Developer Preview: present in responses when commentsViewMode asks for
# them, absent from the public discovery document.

column4: Developer Preview; suggestion threads, carrying the author and status list_suggestions merges in
Developer Preview; maps a comment anchor id to the ranges it covers

column1: # Document-wide header and footer ids. A read reaches a header or footer
# through the Headers/Footers maps, which are keyed by the same ids, so
# reading them from the style as well would be a second spelling of one
# fact. create_header and create_footer take the id from the batchUpdate

column4: headers are reached through Document.headers, keyed by this id
footers are reached through Document.footers, keyed by this id
as defaultHeaderId; page_setup sets useFirstPageHeaderFooter, not the id

column1: # Image detail. insert_object sets a URI and a size; it does not crop,
# rotate or recolour, and no read renders these.

no tool draws a border on an image

the glyph's own styling; no read renders it and no tool sets it
